SELECT t0.sensorid, 
    t0.sensorcode, 
    t4.sensortype, 
    t1.outputvariableid, 
    t2.variableid,
    t2.variablecode, 
    t2.variablename,
    t5.unitsabbreviation,
    t3.boxx,
    t3.boxy,
    t3.dlevel
  FROM sensors t0, sensoroutput t1, variables t2, locations t3, sensortypes t4, units t5
  WHERE t2.variableid IN (3,4,5,6,7,8,9,52,53,54,61,62,63) AND t1.outputvariableid=t2.variableID AND t0.sensorid=t1.sensorid AND t0.locationid=t3.locationid
        AND t0.SensorTypeID=t4.SensorTypeID AND t2.variableunitsid = t5.unitsid
  ORDER BY t2.variableid

Select "DATETIME","tm","rn","ot1","ot2"
FROM
(select to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, variableid as outtype
FROM datavaluesviz
where localdatetime >= '18-JAN-2016' and variableId = 14 and sensorid > 1085 and  sensorid < 1092 and datavalue >= 0
UNION
select to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, variableid+1 as outtype
from datavaluesviz  
where localdatetime >= '18-JAN-2016' and variableId = 14 and sensorid > 1091 and  sensorid < 1098 and datavalue >= 0
UNION
select to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, variableid as outtype
from datavaluesviz  
where variableId = 17 and sensorid >= 1066 and  sensorid <= 1085 and localdatetime >= '18-JAN-2016' and datavalue > 0
UNION
select to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, variableid+2 as outtype
from datavaluesviz  
where variableId = 14 and sensorid = 993 and localdatetime >= '18-JAN-2016' and datavalue >= 0
)
PIVOT (sum(datavalue) FOR outtype IN (17 as "tm", 16 as "rn", 14 as "ot1", 15 as "ot2"))
ORDER BY DateTime

SELECT t0.sensorid, 
    t0.sensorcode, 
    t4.sensortype, 
    t1.outputvariableid, 
    t2.variablecode, 
    t3.boxx,
    t3.boxy,
    t3.dlevel
  FROM sensors t0, sensoroutput t1, variables t2, locations t3, sensortypes t4
  WHERE t0.sensorid=t1.sensorid AND t1.outputvariableid=t2.variableID AND t0.locationid=t3.locationid
        AND t0.SensorTypeID=t4.SensorTypeID

SELECT t0.sensorid, 
    t0.sensorcode, 
    t4.sensortype, 
    t1.outputvariableid, 
    t2.variablecode, 
    t2.variablename, 
    t3.unitsabbreviation, 
    t0.datatablename 
  FROM sensors t0, sensoroutput t1, variables t2, units t3, sensortypes t4
  WHERE t0.sensorid=t1.sensorid AND t1.outputvariableid=t2.variableID AND t2.variableunitsid=t3.unitsid
        AND t0.SensorTypeID=t4.SensorTypeID
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT t0.sensorid, 
    t0.sensorcode, 
    t4.sensortype, 
    t1.outvariableid, 
    t2.variablecode, 
    t2.variablename, 
    t3.unitsabbreviation, 
    t0.datatablename 
  FROM sensors t0, calibrationparameters t1, variables t2, units t3, sensortypes t4
  WHERE t0.sensorid=t1.sensorid AND t1.outvariableid <> t1.invariableid AND t1.outvariableid=t2.variableID AND t2.variableunitsid=t3.unitsid 
        AND t0.SensorTypeID=t4.SensorTypeID

SELECT DISTINCT t5.sensortype,
      t1.outputorder,
      t1.outputvariableid,
      t3.VariableName,
      t4.UnitsAbbreviation,
      t3.nodatavalue,
      t1.validrangefrom,
      t1.validrangeto
    FROM sensoroutput t1,
      sensors t2, 
      variables t3, 
      units t4,
      sensortypes t5 
    WHERE t5.sensortypeid=t2.sensortypeid AND 
      t1.sensorid=t2.sensorid AND 
      t1.outputvariableid=t3.variableid AND 
      t3.variableunitsid=t4.unitsid
    ORDER BY t5.sensortype,
      t1.outputorder,
      t1.outputvariableid

SELECT t1.loggerName,
      t2.module,
      t2.channel,
      t2.address,
      t2.SensorID
    FROM dataloggers t1,
      connectionparameters t2 
    WHERE t1.dataloggersID=t2.dataloggersID
    ORDER BY t2.sensorID

SELECT SensorId, 
    SensorCode, 
    BoxY, 
    BoxX, 
    Dlevel
  FROM Locations t1, Sensors t2
  WHERE t2.LocationID=t1.locationID
  ORDER BY SensorId

SELECT DATETIME,FM1,FM2,FM3,FM4,FM5,FM6 
FROM
(select to_date(to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI'), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, sensorid
from datavaluesviz  
where variableId = 14 and sensorid >= 1092 and sensorid <= 1097)
PIVOT
(AVG(datavalue) FOR sensorid IN (1092 as "FM1", 1093 as "FM2", 1094 as "FM3", 1095 as "FM4", 1096 as "FM5", 1097 as "FM6"))
order by DateTime

SELECT DATETIME,G1,G2,G3,G4,G5,G6 
FROM
(select to_date(to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI'), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, sensorid
from datavaluesviz  
where variableId = 14 and sensorid >= 1086 and sensorid <= 1091)
PIVOT
(AVG(datavalue) FOR sensorid IN (1086 as "G1", 1087 as "G2", 1088 as "G3", 1089 as "G4", 1090 as "G5", 1091 as "G6"))
order by DateTime

SELECT DATETIME,LC0,LC1,LC2,LC3,LC4,LC5,LC6,LC7,LC8,LC9 
FROM
(select to_date(to_char(localdatetime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI'), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') as DateTime, datavalue, sensorid
from datavaluesviz  
where variableId = 17 and sensorid >= 1066 and  sensorid <= 1075)
PIVOT
(AVG(datavalue) FOR sensorid IN (1066 as "LC0", 1067 as "LC1", 1068 as "LC2", 1069 as "LC3", 1070 as "LC4", 1071 as "LC5", 1072 as "LC6", 1073 as "LC7", 1074 as "LC8", 1075 as "LC9"))
order by DateTime

SELECT DateTime, ROUND(LC0+LC1+LC2+LC3+LC4+LC5+LC6+LC7+LC8+LC9, 1) as TotalMass
FROM data_lc_mass
ORDER by DateTime

select
    t1.sensorid,
    t1.sensorcode,
    t2.sensortype,
    t3.methoddescription,
    t1.status,
    t4.loggername,
    t5.module,
    t5.channel,
    t5.address
  FROM sensors t1, sensortypes t2, daqmethods t3, dataloggers t4, connectionparameters t5 
  WHERE t1.sensortypeid=t2.sensortypeid and t3.daqmethodid=t1.daqmethodid and t4.dataloggersid=t5.dataloggersid and t1.sensorid=t5.sensorid 
  ORDER BY sensortype, sensorid

SELECT t1.SensorId, 
    t1.SensorCode, 
    t2.ParameterCode, 
    t2.ParameterValue 
  FROM Sensors t1, Calibrationparameters t2
  WHERE t1.SensorID=t2.SensorID
  ORDER BY SensorId, ParameterCode

SELECT DISTINCT 
      t5.sensortypeId,
      t5.sensortype, 
      t5.sensorName, 
      t5.TABLENAMEVIZ, 
      t1.outputorder,
      t1.outputvariableid,
      t3.VariableName,
      t3.VariableCode,
      t4.UnitsAbbreviation,
      t3.nodatavalue,
      t6.rangefrom,
      t6.rangeto
    FROM sensoroutput t1,
      sensors t2, 
      variables t3, 
      units t4,
      sensortypes t5, 
      dataranges_viz t6
    WHERE 
      t5.sensortypeid=t2.sensortypeid AND 
      t1.sensorid=t2.sensorid AND 
      t1.outputvariableid=t3.variableid AND 
      t3.variableunitsid=t4.unitsid AND 
      t5.sensortypeid=t6.sensortypeid AND 
      t1.outputvariableid=t6.variableid AND 
      t1.outputvariableid NOT IN (1,10,11,13,15,18,19,20,31,32,38,39,42,43,51,52,53,54,55,57,59,60,65,66,67,68,69,71) and
      t5.sensortypeid NOT IN (18)
    ORDER BY t5.sensortype,
      t1.outputorder,
      t1.outputvariableid

select datetime, dt, diff1, diff2, diff3, diff4, diff5, diff6
From (
select datetime, round((datetime - LAG(datetime,1) OVER (ORDER BY datetime))*24*60,0) AS dt, 
fm1 - LAG(fm1,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff1, 
fm2 - LAG(fm2,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff2, 
fm3 - LAG(fm3,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff3, 
fm4 - LAG(fm4,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff4, 
fm5 - LAG(fm5,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff5, 
fm6 - LAG(fm6,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff6 
from DATA_OUT_FLOWMETERS
order by datetime) 
where datetime > (select min(datetime) from DATA_OUT_FLOWMETERS)

select datetime, dt, diff1, diff2, diff3, diff4, diff5, diff6
From (
select datetime, round((datetime - LAG(datetime,1) OVER (ORDER BY datetime))*24*60,0) AS dt, 
g1 - LAG(g1,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff1, 
g2 - LAG(g2,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff2, 
g3 - LAG(g3,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff3, 
g4 - LAG(g4,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff4, 
g5 - LAG(g5,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff5, 
g6 - LAG(g6,1,-9999) OVER (ORDER BY datetime) AS diff6 
from DATA_OUT_RAINGAGES
order by datetime) 
where datetime > (select min(datetime) from DATA_OUT_RAINGAGES)
